title: How Many Reflections Make a Dihedral Set Large?
summary: Given a size-$k$ subset $S$ of a group $G$, how large can the product set $S^n$ be? We study this question, at several layers of refinement, for the infinite dihedral group. First, we give an explicit formula for the maximum size of $S^n$ among all size-$k$ subsets with a prescribed number of reflections. We then determine the optimal number of reflections that a size-$k$ set should contain in order to maximize $|S^n|$.
